Column carries also exclude X = 9 and give 9Y4 when X = 8, after which the remaining digit choices can be enumerated. Both optional routes can establish the bound and its attainment.

Let E_n be the probability of an even number of heads after n tosses, with E_0 = 1. The disjoint possibilities for remaining even give E_(n+1) = (1/3)E_n + (2/3)(1 − E_n). Thus E_(n+1) − 1/2 = (−1/3)(E_n − 1/2), so E_50 = 1/2 + (1/2)(−1/3)^50 = (1/2)(1 + 3^(−50)). The shifted sequence, not E_n itself, is geometric. Alternatively, adding the expansions of (q+p)^50 and (q−p)^50 isolates the even binomial terms. Both routes and the common disjoint-event addition scope are defensible.
limitations: Uses the standard independent-toss model with the same heads probability 2/3 on every toss.
